messages.content: Write a short scene in modern American English about two longtime adult friends walking home together after a long day. Keep the conversation relaxed and natural. Use realistic dialogue, small physical actions, and light humor. Do not introduce any other characters.

“I swear, if tomorrow is anything like today, I’m calling in sick.

Alex glanced sideways at Jordan. “You said that yesterday.”

“And I meant it yesterday too.”

Jordan kicked a bottle cap off the sidewalk and watched it skitter toward the curb. Alex caught up with her, adjusting the strap of her bag when it slipped off her shoulder.

“You know what your problem is?” Alex asked.

“I have several. Be specific.”

“You keep making dramatic threats and then showing up anyway.”

“That’s called responsibility.”

“That’s called complaining with excellent attendance.”

Jordan laughed. “Okay, that was good.”

“I know.”

They walked another block without saying much. It wasn't an awkward silence. After knowing each other that long, neither of them felt the need to fill every quiet moment.

Jordan glanced over. “You still thinking about going out Saturday?”

“Maybe. Depends.”

“On what?”

“On whether you behave yourself.”

Jordan gave her an offended look. “I always behave myself.”

Alex snorted. “That sentence alone proves you don’t.”

Jordan bumped her shoulder against Alex’s. “Fine. But when we’re old and annoying, I’m telling everyone you started it.”

“You already tell everyone I started it.”

“Exactly. I’m planning ahead.”

Alex laughed and shook her head as they kept walking, their pace slowing now that home was getting closer.”
